Integrated the mobile and web clients with 6+ internal marketplace microservices over REST, GraphQL, and Socket.IO/WebSockets using RTK Query, with SSO and session management, feature flags, and environment-specific configuration and certificates; built a GenAI seller-support assistant streaming Claude API / LangChain responses through Node.js middleware.

Shipped through GitHub Actions CI/CD with automated Jest, Supertest, and Detox gates; maintained a reusable component library, migrated screens to the New Architecture (JSI, Fabric, TurboModules), and monitored telemetry, logging, and analytics in Dynatrace.

Led a cross-functional team implementing the React Native (TypeScript) front end for AEP's field operations platform, integrating 10+ microservice REST and GraphQL APIs and complex data-entry workflows used by thousands of utility technicians nationwide.

Implemented SSO and JWT-based authentication, role-based authorization, secure session management, and offline-tolerant data sync for technicians in low-connectivity areas; addressed security fixes and technical debt across the codebase.

Automated build and release pipelines in Azure DevOps with Jest and Detox test gates in two-week Scrum sprints; instrumented Dynatrace telemetry (crash analytics, session replay), cutting P1 mean time to resolution by 50%.

Delivered React Native (TypeScript) iOS and Android features for Walmart's warehouse management system serving 500K+ daily active store associates, consuming Node.js microservice REST APIs with RTK Query / Redux Toolkit and real-time inventory events over WebSockets.

Designed Jest and React Native Testing Library unit and integration testing infrastructure, raising coverage to 80%+ and reducing production regression incidents by 35%; owned features from implementation through validation and App Store / Google Play deployment.

Optimized app load time by 40% via bundle optimization, image caching, list virtualization, and request batching; wrote native modules in Swift and Kotlin and rolled out Dynatrace across 3 apps, cutting MTTR by 50%.

Led development of HCSC Mobile 2.0, a HIPAA-compliant React Native member app for 1M+ Blue Cross Blue Shield of Illinois members: digital ID cards, claims, provider search, push notifications, and secure messaging over REST and GraphQL APIs with SSO, encrypted sessions, and certificate pinning.

Drove architecture, sprint planning, refinement, and feature delivery across hybrid distributed teams; mentored 4 engineers in React Native, Redux, and mobile best practices and introduced structured PR review that improved team velocity by 25%.

Established Jest and Detox testing standards, raising coverage from 45% to 85% and enabling continuous delivery through Jenkins CI/CD to App Store and Google Play releases with feature flags and phased rollouts.
